title: HIERA: Workload-Aware Planning Across Implementation Spaces for GPU Kernel Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2608.21157v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: High-performance GPU kernels underpin modern deep learning and scientific computing. As workloads become increasingly diverse and GPU hardware evolves rapidly, developing efficient methods for automated GPU kernel generation and optimization has become increasingly important. Existing LLM-based methods typically optimize within a fixed implementation space, limiting either optimization flexibility or search efficiency. We propose \textsc{HIERA}, a hierarchical search-space planning framework for GPU kernel optimization. \textsc{HIERA} constructs contract-augmented task specifications, selects an appropriate implementation space across PyTorch operators, CUDA libraries, and custom CUDA kernels, and uses profiling feedback and expert knowledge to guide structured iterative refinement. Experiments on KernelBench across multiple various workload levels and base LLMs show that \textsc{HIERA} delivers stronger overall implementation validity

translated_title: HIERA：面向GPU内核优化的跨实现空间工作负载感知规划
translated_abstract: 高性能GPU内核支撑着现代深度学习和科学计算。随着工作负载日益多样化以及GPU硬件快速发展，开发高效的自动化GPU内核生成与优化方法变得越来越重要。现有的基于大语言模型（LLM）的方法通常会在固定的实现空间内进行优化，这限制了优化灵活性或搜索效率。我们提出了\textsc{HIERA}，一个用于GPU内核优化的层次化搜索空间规划框架。\textsc{HIERA}构建了契约增强的任务规范，在PyTorch算子、CUDA库和自定义CUDA内核之间选择合适的实现空间，并利用性能分析反馈和专家知识来指导结构化的迭代优化。在KernelBench上的多个不同工作负载级别和基础LLM上的实验表明，\textsc{HIERA}在整体实现有效性方面表现更优。
tldr: 提出了一种层次化搜索空间规划框架HIERA，通过跨PyTorch算子、CUDA库和自定义内核动态选择实现空间，并结合性能反馈和专家知识，显著提升了GPU内核优化的有效性与灵活性。
en_tdlr: HIERA, a hierarchical search-space planning framework, dynamically selects implementation spaces across PyTorch operators, CUDA libraries, and custom kernels with profiling feedback and expert knowledge, significantly improving GPU kernel optimization effectiveness and flexibility.
